label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: FedEx St. Jude Championship
items.text: Jordan Spieth leads at 5-under through 16 holes, with Michael Thorbjornsen and Tommy Fleetwood one shot behind at 4-under.

items.headline: DP World Tour vs LIV Golf
items.text: DP World Tour's acquisition moves could significantly weaken LIV Golf after it lost Saudi government funding.

items.headline: McIlroy's FedEx Cup Push
items.text: Rory McIlroy returns to FedEx St. Jude Championship aiming for a fourth FedEx Cup title, starting from 12th in standings.
